rules: Existing v3 contracts remain the baseline until explicitly replaced. New contracts below authorize additive producer/consumer work inside owned files, not guessed persistent semantics.

Gameplay command boundary: source-qualified owner/target, expected canonical revision, request identity, supported operation, admitted/refused result. Only runtime commits canonical mutations. Preserve existing identifiers and transaction types.

Single world authority: application modules compose the existing canonical World host; they do not create a parallel gameplay world or a second save repository. Presentation and engine_bridge consume immutable observations and acknowledged commands. Restore stays prepared until complete scene admission; only then publish the new canonical and displayed revision together.

Scene boundary: world ticket/source generation and retained leases flow to engine_bridge; prepared CPU data, GPU upload completion and simulation readiness are distinct states. No early Ready on spawn.
Movement boundary: input requests -> physics sweep/support/clearance result -> runtime pose commit -> rendering/camera consumer. Camera never becomes canonical body state.

Animation boundary: actor intent -> source-bound asset sampling -> validated palette/attachments -> renderer. Carry source fingerprint, rig order and revision. Missing binding is not identity fallback.

Audio boundary: admitted cue/source generation, playback handle, observable clock, cancellation and completion/error result. Runtime persists intent through its own modules; audio owns device buffers only.

Dialogue boundary: source-selected response plus speaker/target context -> supported compiled effects -> one canonical receipt -> UI and voice. Unsupported conditions are not zero and failed effects are not accepted.

Producer and consumer may implement against existing interfaces immediately. Additive API/schema proposals are recorded once for the owning lead; no per-function grant. Durable format, dependency, source-pin or shared semantics changes need coordinator decision.

Workers submit exact root export/CLI/manifest patch in handoff; coordinator is sole writer of those shared paths. Leads code adapters in their exclusive application/engine_bridge directories; presentation owns existing host entrypoint wiring.

One handoff per coherent feature package, not per method. Leads may integrate owned worker commits into their own staging branches without requesting root approval per merge. Only root merges/promotes main.
